fields.help_en:
The port range of the security group control rule. The port range is determined by the value of the protocol (IpProtocol):

TCP or UDP: Valid values: 1 to 65535. Separate the start port and end port with a forward slash (/). Example: 1/200.
ICMP: -1/-1.
GRE: -1/-1.
If IpProtocol is set to all: -1/-1.

For common ports of typical applications, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40724.html
fields.help_zh:
安全组管控规则的端口范围。由协议（IpProtocol）的取值确定端口的取值范围：

TCP协议或者UDP协议：端口取值范围为1~65535。使用斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口。例如：1/200。
ICMP协议：端口为-1/-1。
GRE协议：端口为-1/-1。
IpProtocol取值为all：端口为-1/-1。

典型应用的常用端口请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40724.html
fields.name: port_range
